response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as global_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(sa.station_avg) - (SELECT global_avg FROM overall_avg) as how_far_above_average FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.global_avg
